name: Pocket Casts
tagline: Follow your podcasts and pick up where you left off
description:
Pocket Casts is a podcast player. Search for a show, subscribe, and new episodes arrive on their own. There is a full screen player, filters for digging out what you have not heard yet, a discover section for finding something new, and a run-down of your listening at the end of the year.

This is the source code for the real app, opened up by its owners at Automattic. It comes with a version for cars running Android Automotive and a Tasker plugin if you like wiring your phone up to do things by itself.

Syncing your subscriptions and progress between devices needs a Pocket Casts account, and the app collects usage analytics.
